description: Ministry of Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order, Bachelor of Education Honours in Teaching English as a Second Language - Benedict XVI Catholic International Institute of Higher Education
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Education exercising powers under the Universities Act to amend the recognition of a degree program at a private higher education institute. While it mentions a government minister by name, the primary focus is on educational regulation and academic standards rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization. The content deals with specialized educational administration that doesn't fit Types 1-9, making it fall under Miscellaneous (Type 10) for educational matters and academic appointments.
